mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of months when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained three-month increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market collapse, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 5.0% during monetary tightening cycles causes negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to elevated borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.
